measured_cost.note: one request per board at page_size=50/max_pages=10, including a 694-job board; 48 boards sit well inside ats_requests_per_round=100

config_effect.reason: the largest market now seeds 44 boards; the cap must cover a market in one round or its tail rotates across rounds

limitations.markets_are_observed_not_declared: each board's markets come from the locations its own jobs reported at probe time, so a board that stops hiring in a market keeps a stale claim until re-verification
limitations.single_lever_board: one Lever board is enough to exercise the adapter but not to characterise Lever pagination under load
limitations.dusseldorf_unmatched: references/markets.json has Munich, Hamburg, Cologne and Frankfurt but no Dusseldorf alias, so trivago's jobs matched no market and the board was rejected for a catalog gap rather than a hiring one
limitations.probe_is_not_a_round: probes ran outside the round request budget and recorded no metrics; they prove reachability, not round behaviour

measured_yield.method: one real sync_registry round per catalog against the stored CV profile (data/ats_phase3_profile_input.json), temp registry, temp metrics, nothing written to the live stores
measured_yield.note: 2.5x the jobs but only +5 candidates: the deterministic prefilter is narrow for this profile's four LLM/AI role names, so most of the added volume is filtered out rather than carried forward
